summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Relais IT marketing site and admin. All 11 backend pytest tests pass (CRUD + validations). Frontend home page, navigation (desktop + mobile), section card counts, contact form (valid + empty), and /admin page (load, refresh, delete) all working as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin route /admin has no authentication gate — currently anyone with the URL can list/delete submissions. Already noted as deferred in test_credentials.md, but recommend at least a basic shared-secret/env-based protection before any production exposure.

Contact form: trim() not applied to fields before validation — whitespace-only nom/objet/message would pass the frontend check (backend Pydantic min_length=1 also accepts whitespace strings). Minor UX/data-quality concern.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per CORS spec; FastAPI/Starlette permits it but browsers will reject credentialed requests. Since no auth/cookies are used today, no functional impact, but should be tightened later.
test_credentials: None — no auth required (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md). /admin is currently open.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed contact submissions via the API and clean up via DELETE. One leftover row remained from an earlier manual test; it was deleted via the admin UI test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and covers POST/GET/DELETE /api/contact incl. 422 validations, descending sort, 404 for unknown delete. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Frontend testids verified: home-page, site-header, header-cta-devis, nav-{accueil,services,solutions,formations,apropos,contact}, mobile-menu-toggle, mobile-menu, mobile-nav-*, service-card-*, solution-card-*, why-card-*, contact-form, input-nom/email/telephone/objet/message, contact-submit, admin-page, admin-refresh, admin-delete, admin-submission, admin-empty.
